title: Insured Care Awaiting a Payer Decision — Patient's Expected Share in Medical Hardship Costs
content:
## Rule

Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), care awaiting its payer's decision is added to the qualifying medical debt documented with the other medical costs at the patient's expected share of it, never at amounts the payer is expected to pay.

The pending insured account is the account listed first among the patient's Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) accounts in insurance pending status.

| Pending insured account | Added |
|---|---|
| an Insured Patient Out-of-Pocket Estimate (Good Faith & Price Estimates) is tied to it — the estimate listed first among the patient's estimates when several are | that estimate's total |
| none tied to it, and point-of-service payments have been posted on that account | those payments, the cost sharing collected at the visit |
| otherwise | nothing |

## Points of judgement

- With both an out-of-pocket estimate and point-of-service payments on the account, the estimate's total is added and the payments are not.
- Hypothetical: no estimate tied; point-of-service payments of 75.00 and 25.00 on the account; 100.00 is added.
